text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What an unexpected—no, what
spectacular
development! The winner of
this year's Satsuki
Sho is...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ack!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Why am I... Why am I here?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Why aren't I in the Winner's Circle?! This
is the
first race of the Triple Crown!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Why can't I achieve what I set out to?!
At this
rate, I...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can't believe she actually got
first place!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
The competition was intense! This
certainly is the
Golden Generation!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
You know... I'm a bit disappointed. I was
hoping
the nepo baby would win.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Her mother's a legend, after all.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine, besides the fact that I
lost.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But don't get the wrong idea. I have no
intention
of giving up at this point.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I fell behind this time, but next time I'll
get the
praise I deserve.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's when I'll be recognized as a
first-rate—no,
as myself.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the next leg of our journey
brings us to
the main event of the
Classics—the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: We have to win!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало and I return to the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer.... See you tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh, King!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: ...Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I thought I saw a familiar face.
I'm glad I
didn't mistake you for
somebody else.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It's pretty late for us to bump into each
other like
this. Does that mean...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You're also going for a run right now?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huh? "Also"?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you're going to run at
this hour?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Yup! I mean... our next race is the
Japanese
Derby, right?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I promised my moms I would be the top

Umamusume in Japan one day.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
That's why I always have to do my very
best. I
especially felt that during today's
race.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Everyone's so good, but I don't want to
let them
take the lead.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I'm doing it for both my mom who gave
birth to
me, and my mom who raised me!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm heading off now! See you
tomorrow at
school!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Her mother has high expectations for
her.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm granting you the right to
accompany
me for one more lap.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: There's no need to worry.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I don't want to give up the lead to
anyone else
either.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That night, Кинг Хало pushes her limits
and
doesn't stop at just one lap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
